'''Paploo''' was a legendary prince in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, who was hidden within a humble family. "Paploo" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Paploo/Legends|the warrior]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SW6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
